the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: adjoint existence by the dual of the partially defined adjoint lemma applied to the class E of products of skyscraper sheaves: every abelian sheaf embeds in such a product (the Godement step, injective by exactness of stalks), and the Hom functor against such a product is representable by reducing to a single skyscraper and using the stalk description of f_!, giving the value of f^! on skyscrapers as the product over the fibre; the module version follows because a module is an abelian sheaf together with a map from Lambda to its endomorphism sheaf (source lines 2387-2452)
